svg.title: Two Marks at the Margin
svg.desc: A direct crop from Legros's drawing shows the Metropolitan Museum stamp beside a handwritten mark in the sheet's lower margin. The museum record separately notes a gift from the artist in 1892.
svg.text: A museum stamp beside a handwritten mark in the same lower edge.
The Met record separately notes a gift from the artist in 1892.
The photograph does not date either mark; the handwriting is left untranscribed.
ALPHONSE LEGROS · HEAD OF A MAN · THE MET · 92.13.1
WINDOW: X 1600–2500 / Y 2860–3284 IN THE MET IMAGE
